meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: Spatial statements, excluding RRBs, from March 2023
meta.coverage: Deposits by type (current, savings, term) by state, bank group and population group (statement 3B), every quarter since March 2023, excluding regional rural banks
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 1417 (data provider DP1), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Foreign banks, Rural, Odisha, current account deposits on 2024-03-01; Foreign banks, Semi urban, Gujarat, aggregate deposits on 2025-03-01; Foreign banks, Semi urban, Gujarat, term deposits on 2025-03-01).
